title: Goongɗinal Suuɗngal Nder Mahol Palaas
intro: E nder caka suudu ñaawirdu tiiɗndu heewndu peeje e mawnikinaare, ruuhu gooto ina jogii sirlu kulɓiniiɗo. Taariiɓe doole e kulhuli maayde, oo maccuɗo Alla ina ndaara nulaaɗo ina darii tan e laamu. So silsil wontii koɗdigal, alaa e sago pellital cuusal waɗee ngam haalde goonga e riis mawɗo e neɗɗo.
clues: Mi hoɗiino e leñol doole mawnikinngol, caloongol maandeeji Alla.
Mi suuɗii gooŋɗinal am haa juuti, tawi wonɓe e sara am ɓee ina njuɓɓina peeje ngam haɓaade nulaaɗo.
Mi haali e peeñcu, mbiy-mi: Mbele aɗa wara neɗɗo gooto sabu ɓe mbiyi joom am ko Alla, tawi hujjaaji laaɓtuɗi ngarii?
Mi jeertinii leñol am ko fayti e baasal leƴƴi ɓennuɗi ɗii e ko fayti e ñalawma noddaango hakkunde mum en.
Mi wi’i ɓe laamɗo mo ngollodinoomi oo hollirta tan ko miijo juutngo, tee laakara ko galle goonga.
mbi’mi: eehey yim6e am ndewee e am mi rewna on e laawol peewal, Alla danndi kam e bonannde feere ma66e.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
